notes.title: Onion Force Update v1.1
notes.content:
We are happy to announce Onion Force has received an update! We believe the changes greatly improve the players experience. 

Some of the most notable changes include:

Gameplay Updates
-   Character movement moved to left analog stick
-   Aiming ranged attacks moved to the right analog stick
-   Fire ranged attack added to the right trigger
-   Zoom in and zoom out moved to up and down on the d-pad
-   Magnetic force applied to players that collects coins and onions as the 
      player walks by
-   Haptic feedback added when player gets damaged

   Bug Fixes
-   Fixed a bug where game crashes when selecting a locked power-up with 
    the controller
-   Fixed a bug where a window prompt appears when unlocking the energy 
    ball power-up
-   Fixed a bug where the tutorial text would refer to the wrong control 
    scheme 

To celebrate the update, Onion Force will be on sale starting tomorrow at 10 a.m. PST! 

We would love to hear your feedback, feel free to leave a review and let us know how you like the improvements. 

Also please leave us any feedback in the discussion page if you have and further suggestions.


Enjoy!

notes.title: Queen Bee Games Launch Onion Force on the Steam Marketplace.
notes.content:
Canadian game developer Queen Bee Games is excited to announce that their first action adventure game, Onion Force, is now available for purchase on the Steam Marketplace and Amazon Digital Game store.  Working with the publishing team at ++Good Games (Double Plus Good Games), Onion Force has been featured on Touch Arcade, TouchGamePlay, TheGameHuntah and has been lauded for it’s “Disney-esque” art style and unforgiving gameplay.   

Onion Force is an Action Adventure, Tower Defense hybrid in which the player has to use cunning and strategy to strengthen a team chosen from a diverse cast of characters that include a Bowman, a Warrior and a Wizard that work together to try and save the last king from his impending doom.  Onion Force is a single player experience that covers 30 levels of action packed mayhem.  Throughout the game, players have to make intelligent choices, collect thousands of pieces of equipment, and build towers that will be most effective for the threat at hand.  Onion Force takes place on multiple terrain types that contain inclement weather conditions, destructible environments and multiple enemy types.  Develop your own play-style across three difficulty modes and try a multitude of approaches in completing each level.  In Onion Force, there are a thousand ways to win and just as many ways to lose as well if you’re not careful.

Drawing inspirations from classics such as Dragon Warrior, Crystalis and Final Fantasy but also some more unexpected influences including Diablo, Dynasty Warriors and Angry Birds, Onion Force aims to be a memorable experience that will make players think and leave them thinking afterwards. A puzzling future awaits!

“After years of dreaming and months of tirelessly working towards a common goal, Onion Force is finally the game it deserves to be,” said the Queen Bee Studios co-founder, Kathleen Cassidy.  Steven Cassidy, Queen Bee's other co-counder and an ex-Disney animator said, “To see one’s brainchild finally enter daylight is both enormously humbling and scary at the same time. I sincerely hope the Steam audience sees the potential that we’ve seen in Onion Force ever since it existed only on the pages of a sketchbook!”

Game features:
- Stand-out cartoon graphics and stellar special effects & animation 
- 3 playable heroes, each with their own unique abilities 
- 6 fully fleshed out locations with 30 expansive levels 
- Thousands of pieces of equipment to collect and equip 
- 8 different towers types with 5 different power levels each 
- Collectable onions to trade for a wide variety of power-ups 
- Adjustable game speed.

The music for Onion Force has been created by Internet music legend, Oxygenfad (est 1996).  This Canadian-born, experimental electronic music sensation brings a devilish collection of compositions that help comprise a ridiculously hardcore, electro soundtrack for Onion Force.  

###

ABOUT Queen Bee Games
Queen Bee Games is an independent game developer founded in 2013 and steeped in the legendary animation tradition of developing memorable, satiable characters. Queen Bee Games is based in Prince Edward Island, Canada, and is committed to delivering high quality gaming experiences among various platforms.  Please visit the official website at http://www.queenbeegames.com for more information.


View the announcement trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T8fbzaotAw8

###

Press Links
Onion Force Website: http://onionforce.com
Announcement Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T8fbzaotAw8

Press Info
Title: Onion Force
Genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Strategy
Platforms: PC, Mac, Linux
Developer: Queen Bee Games
Publisher: ++Good Games (Double Plus Good Games)	
Release Date: Mar 2, 2016
